body:
FINAL (helper-n15, 14 Nov 2026). PR #51 (ready, all checks green: Server run 43591795358 incl. the real-Navidrome job, 12 passed). Item marked BUILT, not walked.
ROOT CAUSE (proof in the first note and audit B-123): 100 of 910 artists have no coverArt; Navidrome 0.64.2's only keyless picture source is a Deezer search by NAME that needs the same name (80 of 100: Bob Marley vs "Bob Marley & The Wailers", Jay-Z vs "JAY Z", names outside Latin letters, channels/labels) and ranks a same-spelling no-picture namesake above the real artist (20 of 100: Bring Me The Horizon, System Of A Down, Mac Miller, Kings Of Leon...). It never retries a miss. B-112's cause was wrong (811 kept-only artists have pictures).
WHAT I CHANGED: artist_finder.py (an artist is identified by one of its own songs via the catalogue track search; picture written as artist.jpg into the artist's own folder under Encore/ by the keeper's own folder rule, placement.artist_folder; hourly errand, <=20 artists and 3 songs each per pass, 1 s pause, a miss remembered a week, migration 0012 artist_picture); deezer.py (one catalogue search: found / knows none / could not ask); B-124 fixed (an outage was stored as 'no cover' for a week); NavidromeClient.artists_without_picture; ADR-R46, audit B-112 corrected + B-123..B-125, PRIVACY.md row, docs/18, CHANGELOG. No phone change, no API change, no screen.
PROOF: dry run on VM 108 data: 97 of the 100 have a folder and evidence songs; unit tests mutation-checked; the integration test proved on Navidrome 0.64.2 that artist.jpg becomes coverArt although a miss was recorded (its first CI run found that Subsonic 'path' of a scanned file is made up from tags: fixed). Deezer: 9 live look-ups in all, by hand.
NOT DONE / FOR YOU TO DECIDE: (1) artists whose songs are only in the Host's own music (3 of 100 here) are not reached; follow-up = Navidrome's native POST /api/artist/{id}/image (ADR-R46 says when). (2) MORE THAN HALF of the 100 are YouTube channels/labels/accounts saved as ARTISTS (KEXP 'Tinariwen - Full Performance (Live on KEXP)', ARTE Concert, Crunchyroll, Earache/SharpTone/Pure Noise Records): they get no picture, rightly; the importer should read 'Artist - Title' from the video title: audit B-125, needs its own item (I did not add one). (3) No Host switch for the catalogue look-ups of the cover finder or of this finder (audit B-88, P3-09): PRIVACY.md says so. (4) Upstream: Navidrome's rank() should rank by fans before exact case and drop placeholder pictures before choosing: outward-facing, your call. (5) Wrong-namesake pictures among the 810 that exist are not looked for. (6) 'No background sweeps': my reading is a bounded hourly errand like the cover finder (<=20 artists per pass, a week's memory); if you want it stricter, per_pass is one constructor argument. (7) Not walked on a phone: the picture arrives at the next sync after the finder's scan; check Bob Marley on the release-candidate pair after a server update.
